title: GTA6 Squeaks Into The Game Awards 2026 Eligibility by One Day
description: Grand Theft Auto 6 is eligible for The Game Awards 2026 by a matter of one day. Can this generation's mega-game break records?
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## GTA6 Secures TGA 2026 Eligibility By a Single Day

The gaming industry has been buzzing with anticipation for Rockstar Games' upcoming mega-game, Grand Theft Auto 6. According to recent reports from Eurogamer, this generation's most anticipated title has narrowly secured its eligibility for **The Game Awards 2026** by the slimmest of margins—a mere matter of one day.

TGA's strict cut-off dates for annual eligibility have always been a talking point for late-year releases. With GTA6 squeaking past the deadline by just 24 hours, the game is officially in the running for the 2026 ceremony, setting the stage for what could be one of the most monumental award show showdowns in video game history.

## Can It Challenge Previous Records?

As the news broke, discussions instantly shifted toward the game's potential dominance at the event. Observers and fans are already wondering if GTA6 can make history and potentially break the record number of wins previously set by titles like *Clair Obscur: Expedition 33*.

While it remains to be seen how the competition will unfold, simply qualifying for the event by such a tight margin adds an extra layer of excitement for players eagerly awaiting the title.

## Editor's Take
GTA6 squeezing into the TGA 2026 eligibility window by a single day is a thrilling technicality. It guarantees that the 2026 award season will feature one of the most fiercely anticipated and heavily contested mega-games in modern gaming history.
